fact: Home Affairs Minister Kazembe said on 17 January 2024, after meeting the Chinese ambassador, that the ZRP Integrated Information System had started, that the police had finished a needs assessment and were at the stage of identifying a partner for the computerisation, to which the ministry was open, and he would not say how much ground had been covered; no funder is named.
title: Police in Zimbabwe looking for computerization partner – Kazembe
